intent: Build Cycles, a macOS/Windows desktop portfolio tracker backed by Google Sheets or local XLSX. The app owns all accounting, validation, cash allocation, permanent cycle/position ownership, stock/option settlement, dated performance/risk, migration and backup. Verify the explicit implementation plan, economic invariants, immutable command replay, failure recovery, native IPC and renderer behavior. Existing tracker inputs must remain intact.

evidence: Explicit plan U4 and U8 / Verification Contract require pnpm test:desktop and pnpm test:google-live.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the planned feature-gated WDIO embedded-driver setup, native workflow suites and scripts, and an explicitly opted-in live Google parity/concurrency suite. Keep test drivers and credentials out of normal release bundles.
findings.title: Native and live acceptance harnesses are missing
findings.why_it_matters: The explicit U4/U8 plan requires runnable native desktop and disposable live-Google suites. The repository currently exposes only Vitest and core/adapter checks; credentials can prevent a live run, but they do not explain missing harness code. CI therefore cannot exercise the planned native boundary on Windows or Mac.
findings.validation_reason: Re-inspected the quoted source and its Rust/renderer callers in the current staged tree. The trigger is reachable through the source/import/editor UI. Incidence was not measured independently; the baseline Number rounding was reproduced read-only on Node 22.13.1. Validation was inline as required by the user.

findings.suggested_fix: Use a documented JavaScript-safe closing baseline ordinal; exclude baseline anchors from normal transaction sequence defaults and test import/edit ordering.
findings.title: Imported baseline orders overflow renderer integers
findings.why_it_matters: An imported baseline order cannot round-trip through JavaScript Number. Editing that cash row or deriving a new same-date order rounds it beyond i64 and native deserialization rejects the save. The read-only Node reproduction returned safe=false and rounded 9223372036854775807 to 9223372036854776000.

findings.suggested_fix: Disable inputs and background mutations during operations, and add a delayed-preview UI test showing the draft cannot change until the matching preview returns.
findings.title: Preview can outlive a changed transaction draft
findings.why_it_matters: While a preview request is pending, form inputs remain editable. A later field change clears the current preview, then the older async response installs its command; saving can commit values different from the visible fields. Background source/filter controls can also overlap in-flight commands.

findings.suggested_fix: Reject missing currency and unknown direction/option-right inputs with the position ID; preserve owner-correctable raw input instead of assigning defaults.
findings.title: Missing legacy facts silently become USD calls
findings.why_it_matters: A supported row with a missing currency is silently valued in USD; an unrecognized option right becomes a call. These choices change P/L and obligations without a reconciliation decision.
findings.validation_reason: Re-inspected the quoted source and its Rust/renderer callers in the current staged tree. The trigger is reachable through the source/import/editor UI. Incidence was not measured independently; the baseline Number rounding was reproduced read-only on Node 22.13.1. Validation was inline as required by the user.

findings.suggested_fix: Clear cycle/account/period selections when opening a different dataset, and add a UI source-switch regression test.
findings.title: Source changes retain incompatible cycle filters
findings.why_it_matters: Opening another dataset leaves the old cycle/account IDs in the filter. Native reports for those unknown IDs are empty, while the new dropdown has no matching option; a populated source can appear empty until manually resetting filters.
findings.validation_reason: Re-inspected the quoted source and its Rust/renderer callers in the current staged tree. The trigger is reachable through the source/import/editor UI.
